writer: Coordinator only; this JSON is a proposal, not a links.json mutation

why: The destination is the Census official poverty measure, defined using pretax cash income. A tax change does not mechanically change this pretax input.
Statistical/legal measure definition; not a guessed actor response.
proposedChange.conditions: Definition is constant where this same Census measure is used; no claim about distinct territorial/local poverty metrics.
proposedChange.reverseOnRepeal: Repealing the tax also has zero mechanical effect on this pretax measure. Earnings, prices, transfers and migration require separate evidence and records.
proposedChange.who: Only the official pretax poverty metric; not take-home income, food insecurity or supplemental poverty.
proposedChange.lagWhy: No direct change at any lag.

evidence.source: Census official poverty definition; Young, Varner, Lurie and Prisinzano 2016, American Sociological Review
evidence.limits: Census primary page read September 30, 2026; direct pretax definition only. No migration or behavioral zero inferred.

patches.personReader: Actual withholding/receipts are separate direct effects, not this inert poverty link
patches.nextStep: Stamp actual tax records with Team2 helper; do not count these already-zero links as newly switched on
